intent: Preserve mission prompt syntax, reject malformed model input before any write, and open older mission deep links beyond the board's first page.
invariants: A literal task tag inside context cannot replace the mission's real task when a stored prompt is parsed for edit.
An ordinary nested task example and CDATA break sequence preserve their accepted round-trip meanings.
A non-string modelId receives a client error without creating or changing a mission; valid and absent model IDs retain their existing behaviour.
An existing mission beyond the first 200 opens by its published query URL at desktop and phone widths; a truly missing ID retains missing feedback.
rollback: Restore the previous parser, validation and lookup only with another implementation that passes the same prompt, no-write and older-link oracle without changing published URLs.
verify_line: Literal CDATA task text in context and ordinary nested task examples round-trip through the stored dispatch prompt; modelId 42 receives 4xx without a mission write; the oldest of 201 seeded missions opens through ?mission= at 1440 and 390 widths, while a nonexistent ID still reports missing.
